However, no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, or domestic-vs-export revenue split figure was retrievable in this session (IndiaMART returned HTTP 429; DuckDuckGo search backend refused connection), so domestic supply volume is not independently quantified.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely claimed: five dated customs/B-L records between 2026-02-24 and 2026-02-28 show real outbound shipments from Nhava Sheva Sea (INNSA1) and Sahar Air Cargo (INBOM4) to the United States, Indonesia, UAE, Netherlands and Qatar, with B/L numbers 1121399, 1090795, 1020610, 9979600. Declared HS codes 290516/290949/292111/292119 are only partly matched by observed rows (29211990 seen; also 34024200, 29224990, 29349920, 29241990) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS set should be widened to the actually observed codes. Domestic: the entity is a genuine NSE-listed manufacturer with 10 plants, so domestic supply is highly plausible, but no GST band or tender/contract record was obtained — status kept at declared_only rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in the sources read; no numbers invented). No sanctions/court/ownership issues were examined in this shipments-only scope.
